national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Launches Nationwide Drive to Boost Free Trade Agreement Utilisation
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal addressed the National Workshop on 'Leveraging FTAs: An Outreach Programme' in New Delhi, urging an outreach campaign across all 780 districts to expand MSME and exporter participation.
India currently operates nine Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) covering economies with a combined GDP of around $60 trillion, giving preferential market access to nearly two-thirds of global trade.
India's exports reached approximately $317 billion during the April-July period (up $36-37 billion year-on-year), supporting the broader objective of becoming a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Visits Ukraine, Reaffirms Support for Peaceful Resolution
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during a three-day visit to Ukraine and Poland.
India stressed the impact of ongoing commercial shipping attacks on Global South supply chains, notably fuel, fertilizer, and food shortages.
India has dispatched 19 consignments of humanitarian aid totaling 160 tonnes to Ukraine, including generator sets, medicines, and medical equipment.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Launch Strategic Dialogue and Sign Key Security Agreements
bullets: India and Belgium launched the India-Belgium Strategic Dialogue and signed a Letter of Intent to strengthen defence manufacturing, regular exchanges, and research.
An MoU was executed between India's Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Federal Police of Belgium to combat cybercrime and transnational crime.
Belgium reaffirmed its support for India's permanent membership bid in a reformed United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

national_news.title: Ukraine Welcomes India's Peace Diplomacy During First Dedicated EAM Visit
bullets: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha welcomed EAM S Jaishankar on the first dedicated bilateral visit by an Indian External Affairs Minister to Ukraine.
Both leaders discussed key global issues, including the restoration of freedom of navigation in the Black Sea and global food security.
Bilateral talks covered expanding partnerships across infrastructure, pharmaceuticals, technological innovation, and digitalization.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Visits Kyiv to Discuss Peace Initiatives and Bilateral Cooperation
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S Jaishankar visited Kyiv, meeting Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to offer support for ending the conflict through diplomacy.
India highlighted that it has dispatched 19 consignments of humanitarian assistance weighing 160 tonnes to Ukraine, including medical supplies and generator sets.
Jaishankar stressed the impact of attacks on commercial shipping in the Global South, emphasizing the need to secure food, fuel, and fertilizer supply chains.

national_news.title: 18th BRICS Intellectual Property Heads Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: The 18th Meeting of the Heads of IP Offices of BRICS Countries was hosted in New Delhi by the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM) under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
Aligned with India's BRICS Chairship theme, 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', the meeting adopted Updated Operational Guidelines to align global IP standards.
Delegates agreed on protection frameworks for traditional knowledge systems, patent analytics for Geographical Indications (GIs), and establishing the IP BRICS FinTech Innovation Monitor.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Unveils 'RAKSHA' Strategic Framework for Defence Diplomacy
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched 'RAKSHA', a comprehensive defence diplomacy document setting out India's strategic 10-year roadmap for global defence partnerships.
The blueprint focuses on four key pillars: strategic partnerships, military capacity building, indigenous defence exports under 'Make-in-India', and maritime security.
The policy reinforces India's operational role as a Net Security Provider and First Responder in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR) to foster long-term global stability.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Agree to Deepen Defence Cooperation and Maritime Security Ties
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh held bilateral talks with Belgium's Defence and Foreign Trade Minister Theo Francken in New Delhi to review defence and industrial collaboration.
Both nations agreed to expand ties through defence cooperation dialogues, joint military training, capacity building, and enhanced maritime security collaboration in the Indo-Pacific region.
The defence meeting was held alongside high-level bilateral discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever.

national_news.title: NHPC Prepared to Begin Execution of 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydropower Project in J&K
bullets: NHPC is set to execute the 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project in Ramban district, Jammu & Kashmir, pending final clearances from the Public Investment Board (PIB) and the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA).

Located in the Chenab basin, the project is a major component of India's strategic push to maximize the utilization of Western Rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty framework.
The infrastructure project spans Ramban, Udhampur, and Reasi districts, requiring 1,401.35 hectares of land, with Ramban accounting for nearly 89% of the total submergence area.

national_news.title: Japan Credit Rating Agency upgrades India's sovereign credit rating to 'A-' with Stable Outlook
bullets: Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCR) upgraded India’s Long-Term Foreign Currency and Local Currency Issuer Ratings from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable Outlook.
The upgrade reflects India's solid economic growth, effective policy implementation, improved fiscal quality, and enhanced soundness of the financial system.
JCR noted the Central Government's fiscal deficit declined from 4.7 percent in FY25 to 4.4 percent in FY26 while maintaining high capital expenditure.

national_news.title: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever Begins Official Visit to India
bullets: Prime Minister of Belgium Bart De Wever initiated a three-day official visit to India, marking the first visit by a Belgian Prime Minister in two decades.
Bilateral talks focus on strengthening cooperation across trade, defense ecosystems, renewable energy, and advancing the India-EU Free Trade Agreement.
Bilateral trade between India and Belgium exceeded $13 billion in 2025-26, heavily anchored by the global diamond trade connecting Antwerp and Mumbai.

national_news.title: Retd Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra Appointed as First CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust
bullets: Former Commander of Western Air Command, Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, was appointed as the first CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya.
The selection was made by a three-member search committee headed by retired Justice Pramod Kohli to oversee administrative and operational functions of the temple complex.
Mishra played a key role in Operation Sindoor and is a recipient of the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and Vishisht Seva Medal.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Valedictory Session of National Departmental Summit on Water
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the valedictory session of the two-day National Departmental Summit on Water, organized by the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
Called for sensitizing Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) to urbanization challenges and water demands by organizing dedicated 'Chintan Shivirs'.
Emphasized 'Jan Bhagidari' through 'Jal Utsav', standard operating procedures (SOPs) for de-silting, dam safety awareness, and leveraging AI for water data governance.

national_news.title: Gujarat Media Delegation Visits CSIR-IIIM Jammu
bullets: A media delegation from Gujarat visited the CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM) in Jammu under a PIB-coordinated tour.
Director Dr Zabeer Ahmed highlighted the institute's work in drug discovery, medicinal plants, and the Aroma Mission leading to the Purple Revolution.
The delegation explored research facilities, the BioNEST Incubator, and startup support ecosystems.

national_news.title: Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) Initiative: Expanding India's Grassroots Exports
bullets: The Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative transforms every district into a center of export planning by identifying local products and services with global potential.
Building upon the One District One Product (ODOP) concept, the DEH initiative covers more than 770 districts across India as of January 2026.
India's total exports of goods and services reached an estimated US$ 863.11 billion in 2025-26, driven by convergence frameworks under the Department of Commerce and DGFT.

national_news.title: India Post Payments Bank Launches Digital Mutual Fund and Insurance Platforms
bullets: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) launched digital platforms for mutual funds and insurance on its 9th Foundation Day.
The platforms provide customers access to mutual fund investments alongside life, health, and general insurance solutions.
As of March 2026, IPPB boasts 13.25 crore customers, with 77% located in rural areas, leveraging the massive network of nearly 1.65 lakh post offices.

national_news.title: Ministry of Statistics Releases Updated GDP Series and Double Deflation Methodology Details
bullets: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released updated annual and quarterly GDP estimates with the base year 2022-23.
The updated series incorporates the Output Producer Price Index (PPI), Banking Services Price Index (BkSPI), and the double-deflation methodology.
MoSPI clarified that a negative implicit GVA deflator in sectors like manufacturing does not imply falling prices, but rather reflects input prices rising faster than output prices.

national_news.title: INS Sudarshini Arrives in Barcelona for Lokayan 2026
bullets: Indian Navy's sail training ship INS Sudarshini arrived in Barcelona, Spain, as part of its ongoing transoceanic expedition, Lokayan 26.
The 10-month expedition commenced in January 2026, serving as a flagship voyage to showcase India's maritime traditions and naval excellence.
During the port call, the ship undertook professional interactions, seamanship exchanges, and cultural engagements with the Spanish Navy and local maritime stakeholders.

national_news.title: Indian Forensic Team Assists in DNA Analysis for Flash Flood Victims in Nepal
bullets: A 19-member Indian forensic team began DNA analysis to help identify victims of recent flash floods in Nepal.
The analysis is being conducted at the Nepal Police Central Forensic Science Laboratory and the National Forensic Science Laboratory in Kathmandu.
The initiative supports Nepal in processing DNA samples from unclaimed bodies as the death toll and number of missing persons continue to rise.

national_news.title: Government Reduces Sugar Stock Limit to 2,000 Quintals to Ensure Price Stability
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution reduced the stock holding limit for sugar dealers from 4,000 quintals to 2,000 quintals.
The new limit is effective from the 15th of the month until November 30th to curb hoarding, speculative trading, and ensure price stability.
Sugar dealers cannot hold stock exceeding 30 days from the date of receipt, while Kolkata and its extended metropolitan areas retain the 4,000 quintal limit.

national_news.title: Indian Men's T20I Squad Announced for Series Against Afghanistan
bullets: BCCI announced a 15-member Indian men's squad led by captain Shreyas Iyer and vice-captain Tilak Varma for a three-match T20I series against Afghanistan in New Delhi.
Fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah makes his return to the national team alongside Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, and Harshit Rana.
The selected squad largely reflects India's team composition for the upcoming Asian Games set to take place in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Ministry Launches Hub & Spoke Operations at Ahmedabad Airport
bullets: Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu launched Hub & Spoke international flight operations at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport in Ahmedabad.
Ahmedabad becomes the third airport in India to join the Hub & Spoke framework for seamless international passenger transit, following Varanasi and Amritsar, with plans to expand to 22 more airports.
The initiative falls under the government's International Aviation Hub Strategy, which aims to make India a preferred aviation hub by 2030 and a leading global hub by 2047.

national_news.title: Union Agriculture Minister Reviews Progress of PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan reviewed the progress of PM-DDKY, targeting holistic agricultural improvement across 100 selected districts.
The scheme operates through the convergence of 36 Central schemes across 11 Ministries and Departments, monitored using 121 key output and outcome indicators.
Approved by the Union Cabinet and launched on October 11, 2025, the program's average performance score across the designated districts rose from 22.54 in April 2026 to 38.85 in July 2026.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Invokes Article 142 to Quash Nationwide FIRs Against Protesting Students
bullets: A Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant invoked special powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to quash and close FIRs registered across states against students protesting the NEET paper leak.
The directive applies to protest incidents that occurred between July 20 and July 25, barring states and Union Territories from registering any fresh FIRs related to these events.

The court recorded the Solicitor General's statement that a central policy to provide financial compensation to families of students who died by suicide post-NEET cancellation will be formulated within three months.

national_news.title: India Participates in G20 FMCBG Meeting in Asheville, US
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman led the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting held in Asheville, US.
Discussions centered on global economic stability, managing sovereign debt, reforming international financial institutions, and promoting sustainable trade.
The host country highlighted that the main G20 Leaders' Summit is scheduled to be held in Miami on December 14-15.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Outlines Risk-Based Customs and Banking Reforms to Sustain Economic Growth
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced proposed customs reforms, including scanner deployment and risk-based automatic import clearances to ease port congestion.
India's foreign exchange reserves reached approximately USD 700 billion, alongside a recorded economic growth rate of 7.8 per cent in Q1.
The government is preparing a high-level review of the banking sector's role to drive the next phase of structural economic reforms.

national_news.title: India Rejects Hague Court of Arbitration Ruling on Indus Waters Treaty
bullets: India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) rejected a ruling by the World Bank-constituted Court of Arbitration in The Hague, declaring the tribunal's decisions legally invalid and lacking jurisdiction.
India reiterated that it did not participate in the arbitration proceedings and maintained that the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty remains in abeyance due to national security concerns.

The ruling called on India to continue observing its obligations under the 1960 treaty, which India rejected on grounds that the arbitration panel itself was established in violation of treaty provisions.

national_news.title: IIT Jammu and NHAI Showcase Key Indigenous Tech and Infrastructure Projects
bullets: IIT Jammu highlighted indigenous innovations including 'Litter Vision', an AI and IoT-enabled system utilizing UAV surveillance to manage plastic waste along fragile Himalayan corridors like the Amarnath Yatra route.
Researchers at IIT Jammu's IC-ResQ Lab demonstrated the indigenous 'iPACE-CHIP' pacemaker chip being developed under the central Chips to Start-up (C2S) Programme.

NHAI reported progress on the Kathua-Katra section of the Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway targeting completion by November 2027, alongside plans for a parallel tube at the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Chenani-Nashri Tunnel.

national_news.title: 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit to be Held in Gandhinagar
bullets: The 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit will take place from 10th to 12th January in Gandhinagar under the theme 'Viksit Gujarat – Shaping Global Future'.
First conceptualised in 2003, the biennial summit has evolved into a global platform for business networking, strategic partnerships, and investments.
The upcoming summit focuses on green hydrogen, green energy, semiconductors, technology, agriculture, and food processing sectors.

national_news.title: Government Notifies Semicon 2.0 Scheme with Rs 1.27 Lakh Crore Outlay
bullets: Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology Ashwini Vaishnaw notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme with an outlay of Rs 1.27 lakh crore across six pillars.
The program aims to embed India deeply into the global semiconductor value chain, spanning from wafer fabrication to end-to-end chip production.
India projects capturing nearly 10% of the global semiconductor market share through sustained policy support, talent development, and ecosystem expansion.

national_news.title: President Addresses Convocation of National Institute of Fashion Technology
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the convocation ceremony of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), highlighting the textile sector's critical role in preserving cultural heritage and generating employment.
Emphasized significant female representation in the fashion and design sector, noting that women accounted for nearly 85% of the graduating students.
Urged students to connect India's traditional craft heritage with global contemporary markets to contribute towards the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: DoT and Himachal Pradesh Partner to Accelerate National Broadband Mission 2.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) partnered with the Himachal Pradesh government to speed up implementation of National Broadband Mission (NBM) 2.0 and Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN)-funded projects.
NBM 2.0 focuses on extending Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) network and high-speed broadband to rural, hilly, border, and unserved areas.
The mission aims to ensure last-mile digital connectivity to primary health centers, schools, Anganwadi centers, and Gram Panchayat offices.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Visits Bishkek for 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on a two-day visit to attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit.
The theme of the summit is '25 Years of the SCO: Together Towards Sustainable Peace, Development and Prosperity', focusing on counter-terrorism and regional stability.
Key engagements include bilateral talks with leaders of Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Iran, and Russia, alongside attending the 6th World Nomad Games.

national_news.title: Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026 Notified by Consumer Affairs Department
bullets: The Department of Consumer Affairs notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, establishing Indian Standard Time (IST) as the unified reference for legal, administrative, commercial, and digital purposes across India, effective 180 days post-gazette notification.

The rules encourage critical sectors—such as banking, telecommunications, railways, and power systems—to adopt NavIC (India's satellite navigation system) and approved domestic timing sources to reduce reliance on foreign satellite time.

As part of the 'One Nation, One Time' initiative, a White Rabbit Technology-based IST Dissemination Demonstration Network was commissioned at RRSL Bengaluru in July 2026 in collaboration with CSIR-NPL, ISRO, SEBI, NSE, and BSNL.

national_news.title: PM Highlights Women Empowerment via PM SVANidhi and Mission ShaktiSAT
bullets: Women account for approximately 46% (around 35 lakh) of total beneficiaries expanding businesses under the PM SVANidhi scheme.
The second phase of 'Mission ShaktiSAT' was launched at Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, offering satellite technology training to 12,000 female students across 108 countries.
PM Modi reiterated focus on the nationwide 'Nasha-mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat' campaign targeting a drug-free youth movement.

national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Elevate Relations to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev agreed to elevate bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in Tashkent.
Key outcomes include establishing a long-term uranium supply deal, three sister-city/sister-state arrangements, and elevating the Joint Commission to Ministerial level.
Both nations established a Coordination Council at the Foreign Minister level to oversee bilateral cooperation.

national_news.title: FSSAI Issues Prohibition Order on Compounded Hing of Major Brands for Substandard Quality
bullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, issued a Prohibition of Sale order for Compounded Hing from Everest Food Products and LG Brand Unit.
Laboratory testing revealed tested Compounded Hing contained only 0–3% alcohol soluble extract, falling short of the mandatory 5% minimum required under FSS Regulations, 2011.
Raw Hing samples collected from LG Brand Unit contained 15% to 32% starch content, significantly violating the statutory ceiling limit of 1%.

national_news.title: Ministry of Education Highlights A Decade of Progress in Higher Education Sector
bullets: Data from the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) shows universities in India grew by 69.6% from 760 in 2014–15 to 1,289 in 2023–24, while colleges increased by 25.3% to 48,246.

Total higher education student enrolment rose by 31.5% to reach 4.50 crore in 2023–24, pushing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) to 30% against the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 target of 50% by 2035.
Female student enrolment grew by 42.2% over the decade, rising from 1.57 crore in 2014–15 to 2.24 crore in 2023–24.

national_news.title: National Sports Day 2026 Observed Across India on August 29
bullets: National Sports Day is celebrated annually on August 29 to mark the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.
The 2026 nationwide campaign was conducted under the call 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein', focused on three pillars: Tribute, Play, and Move.
Budgetary allocation for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports reached over ₹4,400 crore in Union Budget 2026-27, boosting schemes like Khelo India, TOPS, and KIRTI.

national_news.title: India Dispatches Emergency Humanitarian Aid and Rescue Teams to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) coordinated the rescue of 108 Indian nationals following devastating flash floods in Nepal.
India dispatched a C-130J Hercules aircraft carrying 11 tonnes of assistance, an Indian Army tunnel rescue team, and forensic teams for sample analysis.
India has provided 68.5 tonnes of emergency relief material and sent equipment to install eight modular steel and Bailey bridges to restore connectivity.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Uzbek President in Tashkent
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent to strengthen multi-sectoral cooperation.
Key discussion areas included defence, digital connectivity, energy, medicine, agriculture, and mining of rare earth minerals and gold.
Bilateral trade between India and Uzbekistan has grown by 300% over the past decade, with both nations targeting to double the current $1 billion trade.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Investment Potential at Chicago Roundtable
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed a high-level Business Roundtable in Chicago, organized by the Consulate General of India and the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF).

Highlighted India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)—including Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC, and India Stack—and emphasized the evolution of Global Capability Centres into global innovation hubs.
Promoted manufacturing opportunities under Atmanirbhar Bharat, iDEX, and Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes while pitching GIFT IFSC as an international financial hub.

national_news.title: India and Argentina Hold 4th Joint Trade Committee Meeting to Expand Bilateral Ties
bullets: The 4th India-Argentina Joint Trade Committee (JTC) meeting was held in Buenos Aires, co-chaired by Indian Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Argentina's Secretary for International Economic Relations Fernando Brun.

Argentina agreed to work on upgrading India from Annex II to Annex I in its pharmaceutical regulatory framework and progress technical talks on Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) access for Indian agricultural products.

Bilateral trade crossed USD 6.5 billion in 2025 (making India Argentina's 5th largest trading partner), while India's KABIL completed Phase II drilling at its lithium exploration project in Catamarca, Argentina.

national_news.title: Third Vande Bharat Express to Connect Jammu and Srinagar via Udhampur
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh announced the upcoming launch of the third Vande Bharat Express between Jammu and Srinagar, featuring an approved halt at Udhampur.
The rail line expansion highlights major engineering feats in Jammu and Kashmir, including the world's highest railway bridge constructed over the Chenab River in Reasi district.
The expanded railway connectivity from Jammu to the Kashmir Valley aims to boost regional integration, passenger convenience, and tourism.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Clarifies CBG Pricing Framework Under GOBARdhan Scheme
bullets: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas revised the Compressed Biogas (CBG) procurement price under the GOBARdhan Scheme to ₹2,110 per MMBtu (up from ₹1,478 per MMBtu).
Government provides an affordability support of ₹10 per kg of CBG (~₹215 per MMBtu), bringing the effective net cost down to approximately ₹1,895 per MMBtu.
CBG net cost will be distributed across a 2.5 to 3 times wider domestic gas pool to prevent price hikes for CNG and household PNG consumers.

national_news.title: National Sports Day Observed Nationwide to Commemorate Major Dhyan Chand
bullets: National Sports Day celebrated nationwide on the birth anniversary of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand under the call 'Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein'.
Union Budget 2026-27 allocated over ₹4,400 crore to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, a significant increase from ₹1,200 crore in 2013-14.
Key sports milestones highlighted include 29 medals at the Paris 2024 Paralympics, 6 medals at the Paris 2024 Olympics, and 107 medals at the 2023 Asian Games.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Embarks on Two-Day Visit to Uzbekistan
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi undertook a two-day visit to Tashkent at the invitation of Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev to boost bilateral strategic ties.
India ranks among Uzbekistan's top 10 trade partners with bilateral trade standing at around $1 billion, driven by potential in medical, mining, and defence sectors.
Bilateral defence cooperation is bolstered by a Joint Working Group established in 2019 and the annual joint military exercise 'DUSTLIK'.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Begins 6-Day Official Visit to the United States
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is undertaking a six-day official visit to the United States, covering key cities including Chicago, Asheville, and New York.
She will lead the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting under the US G20 Presidency in Asheville.

The visit includes high-level engagements with corporate CEOs, a visit to the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship at the University of Chicago, and participating in the NASDAQ bell-ringing ceremony in New York.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana Marks Major Milestone in Financial Inclusion
bullets: Launched in August 2014, the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) has crossed over 59 crore accounts with total deposits reaching ₹3.17 lakh crore.
Rural and semi-urban areas account for 78% of the total accounts, with women owning nearly 56% of accounts and over 41 crore RuPay cards issued to account holders.
Driven by the Jan-Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) trinity, India's Financial Inclusion Index has improved from 53.9 in 2018 to 67.

national_news.title: Northeast Power Ministers Seek Central Funds for Grid Modernisation and PSDF
bullets: Ministers of the North Eastern Regional Power Committee (NERPC), led by Meghalaya Power Minister Metbah Lyngdoh, urged Union Power Minister Manohar Lal Khattar to provide central funds for modernising the regional power grid.

States requested targeted support under the Power System Development Fund (PSDF) and a larger allocation from the 10% Gross Budgetary Support (GBS) reserved for the Northeast across central ministries.

Priority projects discussed include SCADA/EMS systems, Emergency Restoration Systems (ERS), smart meter check systems, and additional substations to overcome challenging terrain and transmission losses.

national_news.title: Centre Initiates Calibrated Buffer Stock Release of Onions under PSF
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution launched calibrated releases from buffer stock to moderate seasonal onion price volatility, supported by an estimated 2025-26 production of over 307 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT).
The government set a procurement target of 2 LMT Rabi onion for the Price Stabilisation Fund (PSF) buffer for 2026-27, with 1.21 LMT already procured since May 15.
Buffer stock onions are being retailed at Rs 35 per kg through NCCF, NAFED, Safal, and Kendriya Bhandar outlets, alongside bulk rail transit via the 'Kanda Express' from Nashik to Delhi NCR.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Khelo India Dialogue Organised by MY Bharat
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the nationwide Khelo India Dialogue via video conferencing, organized by Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) as part of National Sports Day celebrations across two colleges in every district.

The Prime Minister reiterated the government's commitment to creating a modern sports ecosystem, emphasizing a talent hunt initiative targeting children aged 5 to 15 years to identify their natural athletic aptitudes.
Union Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted key sports reforms including the National Sports Governance Act, Fit India Movement, and 'Sunday on Cycle' fitness drives.

national_news.title: Onam Harvest Festival Celebrated Across Kerala
bullets: Onam is the major harvest festival of Kerala, celebrated to mark the arrival of the new harvest season and welcome the legendary King Mahabali.
Key cultural traditions of the festival include Ona Pookkalam (floral carpets), Ona Sadya (traditional feast), Vallam Kali (snake boat races), and traditional folk dances.
Special prayers and rituals were conducted across major temples in the state, including Sabarimala, Aranmula, and Guruvayur.

national_news.title: Bihar Puts Six Districts on High Alert Following Nepal Flash Floods
bullets: Bihar placed six districts along the Gandak River basin—West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali—under heightened vigilance.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) deployed 9 teams in Bihar and 11 in Uttar Pradesh to prepare for potential river overflows.
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired high-level review meetings, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah assuring Central assistance.
