national_news.title: India Dispatches 10 Tonnes of HADR Material to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi communicated with Nepalese PM Balendra Shah, offering full support and solidarity during the flood disaster.
India dispatched 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) supplies along with essential medicines to Nepal.
Top Indian leadership, including President Droupadi Murmu and EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar, pledged full assistance for relief operations.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / BPSC - Disaster Relief & Bilateral Relations

national_news.title: Flash Floods Hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River Affecting Over 100 Indian Pilgrims
bullets: Severe flash floods surged through Nepal's Bhote Koshi River in the Rasuwa region near the Tibet border, triggered by an earthquake that caused an avalanche.
Over 100 Indian citizens and 37 NRIs traveling for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra were reported missing among nearly 500 affected people.
The deluge caused widespread destruction across Rasuwa, Dhading, Nuwakot, and Chitwan districts, damaging key infrastructure including four permanent bridges.

national_news.title: Bihar Steps Up Preparedness Along Gandak River Basin Amid Flood Threat
bullets: Bihar placed six districts—West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali—on high alert due to rising water levels in the Gandak River triggered by flash floods in Nepal.
NDRF teams have been deployed in Gopalganj and Bettiah, with additional emergency response units stationed on standby in Muzaffarpur.
Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting in Patna, while Union Home Minister Amit Shah assured full Central NDRF assistance to Bihar.

national_news.title: India Assures Full Humanitarian Assistance to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah, assuring full Indian humanitarian assistance following severe flash floods in Nepal.
Indian rescue teams are coordinating closely with Nepalese authorities to support ongoing disaster relief and search operations.
The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu and the Tamil Nadu government established dedicated emergency help desks to assist stranded Indian tourists and residents.

national_news.title: India and Seychelles Discuss MoU for Cooperation in Fisheries and Blue Economy
bullets: Seychelles proposed accelerating a bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with India focused on fisheries, marine aquaculture, tuna processing, and blue economy cooperation.
The high-level bilateral discussions were led by Seychelles Minister Wallace Cosgrow and India's Department of Fisheries Secretary Abhilaksh Likhi.
During the meeting, India highlighted its key achievements, including achieving a national fish production of 19.7 million tonnes and seafood exports worth USD 8.46 billion.

national_news.title: PM Modi Chairs PRAGATI Review; Demands Strict Quality Audits and Action on Cyber Frauds
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the monthly PRAGATI interaction, reviewing 6 critical infrastructure projects worth over Rs 30,000 crore across railway, road, and power sectors in 9 states.
Raised serious concerns over quality lapses in public construction projects, questioning the effectiveness of third-party audits and suggesting the need for stricter supervision.
Directed targeted prevention campaigns against cyber threats like 'digital arrests', prioritizing education for vulnerable groups like senior citizens and youth.

national_news.title: IMA Issues Health Advisory on H1N1 Surge and Warns Against Antibiotic Misuse
bullets: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) issued a public health advisory regarding the seasonal spike in Influenza A (H1N1) cases, emphasizing that the infection is self-limiting and requires no panic.
Strictly cautioned against over-the-counter consumption of antibiotics like azithromycin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, and cefixime, stressing that antibiotics do not treat viral infections.
Advised public adoption of preventive measures such as frequent handwashing, respiratory hygiene, and mask usage in crowded spaces.

national_news.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman Highlights India's Growth Story and Digital Ecosystem in Canada
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed the Indian business community in Toronto during a four-day official visit to Canada focused on trade, investment, and financial cooperation.
Highlighted India's position as the fastest-growing major economy, driven by rapid urbanisation, an expanding middle class, and world-class digital financial infrastructure.
Reaffirmed commitment to a future-focused strategic partnership following the bilateral reset agreed upon during the June 2025 G7 Summit.

national_news.title: Regional Rural Banks Register Highest-Ever Net Profit of Rs 10,176 Crore in FY26
bullets: India's 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) achieved a record consolidated net profit of Rs 10,176 crore in FY26, representing a 49% jump from Rs 6,820 crore in the previous fiscal year.
Asset quality reached historic lows with Gross NPAs dropping to 5.3% and Net NPAs to 2.1%, while total business crossed Rs 13.5 lakh crore and the Credit-Deposit ratio hit an all-time high of 75.2%.
Operating across 22,273 branches in 26 states and 3 UTs, RRBs met all Priority Sector Lending targets and opened over 54.98 lakh new Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts.

national_news.title: Home Minister Sets One-Year Target for 100% Implementation of New Criminal Laws
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the National Security Strategies Conference (NSSC) in New Delhi, setting a 100% implementation deadline for the three new criminal justice laws within one year.
The goal is to ensure case resolution up to the Supreme Court level within three years and increase the overall conviction rate by 25%.

Key initiatives outlined include the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' based on the 'Detect, Disrupt, Destroy' strategy, a quadrilateral border security approach, and integrating platforms like CCTNS, ICJS, NatGrid, and NAFIS.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / Civil Services Polity & Internal Security

national_news.title: National Traders' Welfare Board Conducts 100th Virtual Interaction Meeting
bullets: The National Traders' Welfare Board (NTWB), under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, held its 100th Virtual Conference Interaction Meeting chaired by Chairman Sunil J. Singhi.
The weekly virtual interaction platform was established in July 2024 to facilitate continuous institutionalized dialogue between retail traders and the government.
The platform serves as an accessible mechanism to disseminate information on welfare schemes, receive policy suggestions, and address grievances from small, medium, and large traders.

national_news.title: India pitches as global data centre hub during India-Japan high-level talks
bullets: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry, Akazawa Ryosei, in Tokyo to strengthen economic ties across trade, technology, investments, and tourism.
The Indian government announced plans to create a framework exempting high-tech sector companies from mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification for manufacturing equipment.
India has received $200 billion in investment commitments from global hyperscalers, with Indian semiconductor demand projected to reach $150 billion by 2032.

national_news.title: Supreme Court to set up special bench on OBC creamy-layer criteria plea
bullets: The Supreme Court agreed to consider forming a special bench to hear the Department of Personnel and Training's (DoPT) plea regarding OBC creamy-layer criteria for Civil Services Examination 2025 candidates.

The plea arises from the SC's March 11 judgment in the Union of India vs Rohith Nathan case, which ruled that an October 2004 clarifying letter cannot override the September 8, 1993 Office Memorandum.

The SC previously held that parental salary or income in public or private sector employment cannot by itself determine creamy-layer exclusion without considering post status and wealth tests under the 1993 OM.

national_news.title: PM Modi marks 10-year milestone of Unified Payments Interface
bullets: Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched in 2016 as a major pillar of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), completed 10 years of operation.
The interoperable, real-time digital payment system has achieved global recognition and is currently operational across 11 countries.
Finance Ministry data shows annual UPI transaction volume grew from 1.78 crore in 2016-17 to over 24,162 crore in 2025-26, with transaction value expanding to nearly Rs 314 lakh crore.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Reassures Public on Seasonal H1N1 Antigenic Drift
bullets: Pan-India surveillance led by MoHFW, ICMR, DHR, and NCDC across 73 VRDL facilities confirmed circulating H1N1 viruses belong to clade 6B.1A.5a2a (subclade D.3.1.1).
ICMR DG Dr. Rajiv Bahl clarified that observed minor genetic changes represent standard seasonal antigenic drift rather than a novel public health threat.
Advisories highlight routine hygiene measures and targeted medical care for vulnerable demographics including the elderly, young children, and immunocompromised individuals.

national_news.title: Bihar Participates in National Conference of I&PR Secretaries in New Delhi
bullets: Bihar Information and Public Relations Department Secretary Naveen Kumar represented the state at the National Conference of Information and Public Relations Secretaries held at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
Key topics discussed included the framework for WAVES 2027, 'WAVES Bazaar', capacity building via the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), and the 'India Cine Hub' single-window portal.
Deliberations covered the digital transition of media registration through the Press Sewa Portal under the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Act, 2023.
national_news.exam_tag: BPSC / Bihar State Governance & Central Initiatives

national_news.title: MoHFW and ICMR Monitor Seasonal Influenza Trends via Pan-India VRDL Network
bullets: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), along with DHR, ICMR, and NCDC, is monitoring national respiratory illness trends through 73 Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDLs).
ICMR Director General Dr. Rajiv Bahl confirmed that circulating Influenza A (H1N1) matches the A/Missouri/11/2025 (H1N1) pdm09-like virus, classified under clade 6B.1A.5a2a and subclade D.3.1.1.
Genomic surveillance indicates routine antigenic drift consistent with standard seasonal behavior, with no evidence of a new or high-risk influenza strain.

national_news.title: India Post Launches Upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa Applications
bullets: Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia launched the upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile apps along with inaugurating 14 renovated post office buildings across India.
The applications were developed indigenously by the Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology (CEPT) under the Advanced Postal Technology (APT) platform as part of DoP IT 2.0 Modernization.
Dak Sewa provides unified postal services across 23 Indian languages, while Dak MITRA equips postal personnel with digital tools for doorstep service delivery.

national_news.title: AIIA Launches 'Garbhini Mitra' Maternal Care Skill-Development Course
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, launched the 'Garbhini Mitra' course, a six-month offline healthcare skill-development training program for maternal care.
The program integrates classical Ayurvedic frameworks—Garbhadhana Vidhi, Garbhini Paricharya, and Sutika Paricharya—with modern non-clinical healthcare protocols like Basic Life Support (BLS).
Eligible for candidates completing Senior Secondary (10+2) education, the course aims to create community healthcare guides for holistic antenatal, postnatal, and pre-conceptional support.

national_news.title: Puducherry Government Introduces Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026
bullets: The Government of Puducherry introduced the Puducherry Business Reforms Bill, 2026 to shift business regulation from permission-based control to a rule-based governance model.
The Bill extends approval exemptions for MSMEs to five years, with a provision for a one-year extension, and introduces auto-generation of Acknowledgement Certificates if not issued on time.
It strengthens 'Invest Puducherry' as a single point of contact for investors and establishes an auto-appeal mechanism for applicants against rejected proposals.

national_news.title: RBI's USD-INR Swap Facility Mobilizes USD 73 Billion in Forex Inflows
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India's special USD-INR forex swap facility launched on June 8, 2026, mobilized total forex inflows of US $73 billion as of August 21, 2026.
FCNR(B) deposits alone accounted for US $65.40 billion, driven by an overwhelming response from Non-Resident Indians (NRIs).
The RBI advanced the closure of the FCNR(B) window from September 30 to August 31, 2026, after achieving its objectives ahead of schedule, comfortably surpassing the 2013 swap scheme.

national_news.title: Union Home Minister Inaugurates 9th National Security Strategies Conference-2026
bullets: Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference-2026 in New Delhi, featuring over 850 hybrid participants.
Directed the integration of AI-based analysis on Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) intelligence platforms to formulate SOPs for national security threats.
Stressed full implementation of the Home Ministry's PRAHAAR scheme, expedited trial in absentia provisions for fugitives, and streamlined UAPA investigations.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Urges Young IFS Trainees to Strengthen Grassroots Global Engagement
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with 50 Officer Trainees of the 2025 Batch of the Indian Foreign Service (IFS) at Seva Teerth.
Advised diplomats to blend India's civilisational strengths with technology, innovation, AI, and gaming to boost global outreach.
Encouraged leveraging the 'Bharat ko Janiye' (Know India) Quiz to engage global youth and promote India as a premier international tourism destination.

national_news.title: ISMA Projects Sugar Price Stabilization Amid Sufficient Domestic Availability
bullets: The Indian Sugar and Bio-energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) stated that domestic sugar prices are expected to cool off due to adequate stock availability, attributing the recent price surge to speculative and panic buying.
ISMA requested a reduction in the sugar holding limit for traders from 400 tonnes to 200 tonnes to release more stock into the retail market.
The Union Government announced the import of 10 lakh tonnes of sugar as a precautionary measure to maintain comfortable stock levels.

national_news.title: India Targets $1 Trillion Chemical Sector Economy by 2040
bullets: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilisers J.P. Nadda announced a strategic target to expand India's chemical sector to $1 trillion by 2040 during a CEO Roundtable in New Delhi.
The government highlighted key sectoral reforms and policy interventions including Bhavya Rasayan, Coal Gasification, Rare Earth Corridors, and the Critical Mineral Mission.
Invest India and the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals outlined plans to establish an institutionalized dialogue mechanism to enhance domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investments.

national_news.title: Union Sports Ministry Launches 'Khelo India Samvad' Initiative
bullets: The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports organized 'Khelo India Samvad – Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath' across colleges in Punjab, Haryana, and Chandigarh.
Executed through the Department of Youth Affairs' 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) portal, the drive connects youth with national sports and fitness goals.
The initiative promotes youth engagement via the MY Bharat Suggestions Box and encourages participation in the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) Quiz.

national_news.title: 9th National Security Strategies Conference Inaugurated in New Delhi
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 9th National Security Strategies Conference in New Delhi, calling for AI-based analysis on Multi-Agency Centre (MAC) platforms to build SOPs against security threats.
The Home Minister stressed training officers under the MHA's PRAHAAR scheme, using 'trial in absentia' provisions for fugitives, and taking an integrated approach in UAPA investigations.
Held annually in a hybrid format since 2021 following PM Modi's directives, the conference brings together domain experts and over 850 police leadership delegates.

national_news.title: India to Amend Regulations to Boost Manufacturing Investments from Japan
bullets: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal led a 200-business delegation across Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka to strengthen India-Japan economic partnerships.
Announced regulatory updates within two months to resolve investor issues in key areas like semiconductor equipment manufacturing and automotive components.
Engaged in active dialogues on ethical AI usage, clean energy, healthcare, and leveraging free trade agreements for global market access.

national_news.title: India Calls for Sustained Finance for Land Restoration at UNCCD COP17
bullets: Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav addressed the Ministerial Dialogue at the 17th Conference of Parties (COP17) to UNCCD held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.
Highlighted India's Green Credit Programme, where credits are awarded after five years of restoration on achieving at least 40% canopy density on degraded land.
Emphasized the use of Sovereign Green Bonds and blended green finance to mobilize capital for drought resilience, compensatory afforestation, and biodiversity conservation.

national_news.title: NSA Ajit Doval Visits Beijing for 25th India-China Boundary Talks
bullets: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval visited Beijing to participate in the 25th round of Special Representatives (SR) talks on border issues with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi.
The SR talks mechanism was established in 2003 to comprehensively address boundary disputes along the 3,400 km India-China border.
Discussions focused on border stability following the 2020 Galwan Valley standoff, reiterating that border peace is a prerequisite for normalizing overall bilateral relations.

national_news.title: India and Russia Review Bilateral Cooperation and $100 Billion Trade Target
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Russian President Vladimir Putin and co-chaired the India-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission meeting in Moscow with First Deputy PM Denis Manturov.
Both countries highlighted steps to achieve the $100 billion bilateral trade target by 2030, addressing tariff/non-tariff barriers, market access, and payment mechanisms.
Key sectors discussed for expanded cooperation included energy, fertilizers, trade, and nuclear energy ahead of upcoming SCO and BRICS summits.

national_news.title: AAI Seeks Rs 1,200-Crore Approval for New Terminal at Bhubaneswar Airport
bullets: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has submitted a proposal to the Union Finance Ministry's Public Investment Board (PIB) for constructing Terminal 3 (T3) at Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar.
Estimated at a cost of over Rs 1,200 crore, the proposed T3 will integrate both domestic and international operations under one roof.
The new terminal is designed to handle 8.6 million passengers per annum (MPPA) and will feature six additional aerobridges.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Launches Rs 3,400 Crore Defence Infrastructure Projects in West Bengal
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh presided over the Bhumi Pujan for five projects of Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) and Yantra India Limited (YIL) worth approximately Rs 3,400 crore in West Bengal.
The infrastructure projects, situated across Kidderpore, Shalimar, Raichak, and Ishapore, aim to enhance domestic shipbuilding capacity, quality maintenance services, and export potential.
GRSE, a Navratna Defense Public Sector Undertaking (DPSU) that has delivered over 100 vessels, is currently manufacturing a cargo ship for Germany under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: India Celebrates 3rd National Space Day Highlighting $45-Billion Space Economy Vision
bullets: India celebrated National Space Day on August 23, marking the historic anniversary of Chandrayaan-3's successful landing on the Moon's south polar region in 2023.

Addressing the 3rd National Space Day celebrations in Ahmedabad, leaders emphasized space sector reforms designed to drive India towards a $45-billion space economy and support the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the growing role of private space startups, Gen-Z engineers, and global investment in expanding India's space ecosystem.

national_news.title: Rohit Yadav and Murali Sreeshankar Clinch Gold at World Athletics Continental Tour
bullets: Rohit Yadav secured the javelin throw title with a personal best of 87.68 metres at the World Athletics Silver Level Continental Tour at Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar.
Murali Sreeshankar won the men's long jump title with an 8.07-metre jump, while Ancy Sojan secured victory in the women's long jump with 6.71 metres.
19-year-old Abinaya Rajarajan reclaimed the Indian U-20 national record in the women's 100m event after winning with a timing of 11.34 seconds.

national_news.title: India Must Move from 'Pharmacy' to 'Laboratory of the World': Union Minister Anupriya Patel
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Anupriya Patel addressed the 3rd edition of the IIMA Healthcare Summit on 'Advancing AI in Healthcare' at IIM Ahmedabad.
Highlighted the setting up of Centres of Excellence for AI in healthcare at AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and AIIMS Rishikesh.
Emphasized the ₹5,000 crore Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech Sector (PRIP) scheme to boost innovation-led industry-academia research collaboration.

national_news.title: Visakhapatnam Hosts BRICS Youth and Sports Ministers' Meetings 2026
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting and BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
Delegates from 11 BRICS member countries participated in discussions focused on youth empowerment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and sports cooperation under India's BRICS Presidency 2026.
As part of the visit, international delegates toured the historic Thotlakonda Buddhist heritage site near Visakhapatnam and participated in the 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' tree plantation drive.

national_news.title: Union Home Ministry to Form High-Level Committee for Gorkha Issues
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a high-level meeting with senior Gorkha leaders and state officials in Sukna, Siliguri.
A high-level committee will be constituted under Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director and Deputy NSA) to address and resolve issues pertaining to the Gorkha community.
Leaders across political lines agreed to work towards a resolution for the Darjeeling Hills, Terai, and Dooars regions within the constitutional framework.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Roadmap for Next-Generation Governance and Economic Reforms
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, stating that economic and governance reforms are a commitment and conviction for his administration.
Highlighted the transition from a restrictive regulatory approach to modern policy frameworks like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme to generate employment and drive growth.
Noted that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects India to remain the world's fastest-growing major economy despite global macroeconomic uncertainties.

national_news.title: BRICS Tourism Ministers Adopt 'Jaipur Declaration' Under India's Chairship
bullets: BRICS Tourism Ministers unanimously adopted the Jaipur Declaration during a meeting presided over by Union Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat in Jaipur.
The meeting was centered around the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' to strengthen intra-BRICS tourism ties.
The declaration focuses on four key priorities: AI & Digital Technology in Tourism, Sustainable Practices, Skilling & Capacity Building, and Seamless Travel Facilitation.

national_news.title: HM Amit Shah Reviews Border Fencing and Proposes Triangular Defense Grid for Siliguri Corridor
bullets: Over 1,129 acres of land handed over to BSF and SSB for border fencing along the India-Bangladesh border in West Bengal to prevent illegal infiltration.
A triangular grid of Army posts in Chopra, Dhubri, and Kishanganj will be set up to protect the strategically crucial Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').
Laid foundation stones for projects worth ₹189 crore at SSB Frontier HQ in Siliguri and inaugurated an awareness exhibition on three new criminal laws including Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

national_news.title: India Hosts 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation Ministerial Meeting in Chennai
bullets: The 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting was held in Chennai, chaired by Union Minister of State for Science and Technology Jitendra Singh.
Under India's BRICS Presidency, the central theme for STI cooperation was selected as 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
India urged member nations to deepen cooperation in frontier areas such as AI, quantum technology, BioE3 policy, high-performance computing, and innovation financing for the Global South.

national_news.title: Legendary Odia Playback Singer Pranab Patnaik Passes Away at 88
bullets: Renowned Odia playback singer Pranab Patnaik passed away in Bhubaneswar at the age of 88, ending a career spanning over five decades.
He began his playback journey in 1958, sang for over 200 films, and won the Odisha State Film Award seven times.
He was honoured with the prestigious Jayadev Puraskar for his lifetime contribution to Odia cinema and musical heritage.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Economic Times World Leaders Forum, Emphasizes Economic Growth Momentum
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Economic Times World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, describing India as a global bright spot for growth.
Highlighted the government's shift from a restrictive regulatory framework to a Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) model to boost manufacturing and employment.
Reiterated India's commitment to global shared growth guided by the G20 presidency theme of 'One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

national_news.title: India and Brazil Sign MoU for Bilateral Telecom and ICT Cooperation
bullets: India and Brazil signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs) on the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting in Pune.
The MoU was signed by Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia and Brazilian Minister of Communications Frederico de Siqueira Filho.
Key focus areas include Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), cybersecurity, universal connectivity, emerging technologies, and joint alignment ahead of India's BRICS Chairship in 2026.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Founders and CEOs of 20 Space Startups in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with CEOs and founders of 20 Indian space startups, including Skyroot Aerospace, Agnikul Cosmos, Pixxel, Dhruva Space, Bellatrix Aerospace, and Digantara.
The PM urged startups to expand space technology applications into everyday development areas, such as agriculture, livestock management, dairy, and environmental protection.
He stressed the importance of partnering with Atal Tinkering Labs to foster scientific curiosity among youth and build India into a commercially viable global space hub.

national_news.title: BWF World Championships 2026: Indian Doubles Pairs Advance to Quarterfinals in New Delhi
bullets: Men's doubles duo Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi by defeating Malaysia's Junaidi Arif and Roy King Yap.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals after defeating Japan's seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in straight games.
PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and the mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto ended their tournament runs following pre-quarterfinal defeats.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated Across Manipur
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day was celebrated to commemorate the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India on August 20, 1992.
The state-level event was held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) in Imphal under the theme 'State Song ‘Sana Leibak Manipur’ for Peace, Unity and Integrity'.
State Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam announced that the government will make concerted efforts to secure Classical Language status for Manipuri before the next year's celebration.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
The meeting emphasized an accelerated sports talent hunt across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board to structure coach development.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Investigate Student Protest Violence
bullets: The Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC) headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The panel will independently examine allegations of excessive police force and violence by protesters during nationwide student demonstrations.
The HPEC has been directed to submit periodic interim reports, prioritizing targeted violence and harassment of female protesters.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day was celebrated across Manipur to commemorate the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution on August 20, 1992.
The state-level event was held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) in Imphal under the theme 'State Song ‘Sana Leibak Manipur’ for Peace, Unity and Integrity'.
The State Home Minister announced government efforts to secure Classical Language status for Manipuri before the next year's celebration.

national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Reach BWF World Championships Quarterfinals
bullets: Indian women's doubles badminton pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi.
Defeated seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi of Japan in straight games (21-16, 21-12).
Other top Indian shuttlers like P V Sindhu, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, and Chirag Shetty also feature in the tournament.

national_news.title: Mansukh Mandaviya Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
Emphasized a comprehensive sports talent hunt across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board for structured coach development.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Probe Student Protest Violence
bullets: Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The committee will independently examine allegations of violence during student demonstrations at Jantar Mantar and other locations.
The bench comprised Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V Mohana.

national_news.title: Centre Unveils Delhi Master Plan 2047 for Sustainable Urban Growth
bullets: Union Government unveiled the Delhi Master Plan 2047 to transform the national capital into a world-class, inclusive, and economically vibrant city for 3.2 crore people.
The plan aligns with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047 and adopts area-based redevelopment for brownfield areas and Right Of Way-based planning for greenfield areas.
Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal stated that around 40 lakh new affordable housing units will be added in the coming years.

bihar_news.title: India's Total Foodgrain Production Estimated at 376.56 Million Tonnes for 2025-26
bullets: India's total foodgrain production is estimated at 376.563 million tonnes as per the Third Advance Estimates (2025-26), reflecting a 5.3% (18.8 million tonnes) increase over the previous year.
Under the Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector launched in 2023, godown construction was completed in 313 Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) as of July 2026.
The storage initiative has generated over 1.80 lakh metric tonnes (LMT) of storage capacity closer to production centres to reduce post-harvest wastage and avoid distress sales.

bihar_news.title: India's REPM Scheme Receives 20 Bids for Rare Earth Permanent Magnet Manufacturing
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids from prominent engineering, energy, recycling, and international firms to establish integrated Rare Earth Permanent Magnet (REPM) manufacturing facilities.
The scheme targets establishing 6,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) of integrated REPM manufacturing capacity in India, with up to five beneficiaries eligible for up to 1,200 MTPA capacity each.

The initiative aims to build an end-to-end processing value chain ranging from Neodymium-Praseodymium (NdPr) oxide to finished magnets for high-tech sectors like electric mobility, semiconductors, and renewables.

bihar_news.title: Severe Flood Situation Grips Bihar as Major Rivers Rise
bullets: The flood situation worsened across North, Central, and South Bihar due to rising waters in the Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, and Son rivers.
Bhagalpur remains the worst-affected district, while low-lying areas in Patna, Buxar, Bhojpur, Samastipur, and Vaishali are impacted.
All 69 gates of the Indrapuri Barrage on the Son River were opened following water release from the Bansagar Dam in Rohtas.

bihar_news.title: India's Record Wheat Harvest Opens $1.5 Billion Export Window
bullets: According to an ASSOCHAM report, India's record wheat harvest and policy shifts are expected to unlock over $1.5 billion in export opportunities.
The government liberalized export rules by shifting specified wheat varieties, atta, maida, and semolina from 'Prohibited' to 'Free'.
India produced a record 121 million metric tonnes (MMT) of wheat in 2025-26 against domestic consumption of 111 MMT, with central pool stocks at 51.3 MMT against a buffer norm of 27.5 MMT.

bihar_news.title: HUDCO Signs Rs 25,000 Crore MoU with Bihar Government for Industrial Infrastructure
bullets: Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) signed an MoU with the Government of Bihar on September 2, 2026, in Patna.
HUDCO will provide financial assistance of up to Rs 25,000 crore over five years as term loans for industrial infrastructure development, including land acquisition for industrial parks.
The loans feature flexible repayment terms of up to 25 years with a moratorium period, implemented through the state's Infrastructure Development Authority (IDA).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Fisheries Department Advises Caution on Unknown Fish Species
bullets: The Department of Dairy, Fisheries and Animal Resources issued a public advisory regarding unusual catfish species arriving via Nepal floodwaters.
The advisory outlines strict safety protocols, urging citizens to report unknown fish and seek immediate medical help if symptoms like vomiting or diarrhea occur.
Experts identified the large freshwater species as the Goonch catfish (Bagarius bagarius), native to fast-flowing rivers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Intensifies Flood Control and Anti-Erosion Measures Along the Ganga
bullets: Severe erosion along the Ganga in Bhagalpur washed away temples and parts of the Zamindari embankment in Naugachhia block.
Water Resources Department teams are working on a war footing, citing an unexpected change in the course of the Ganga.
Flooding and rising water levels were also reported in Saran, Vaishali, Begusarai, Buxar, Jehanabad, Nawada, and Aurangabad.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Identifies Over 8 Lakh Manuscripts for Digitisation Under Gyan Bharatam Mission
bullets: Bihar has identified over 8 lakh rare palm-leaf and paper manuscripts across all 38 districts for digitisation under the central Gyan Bharatam Mission.
An administrative approval of Rs 6.23 crore was granted to accelerate conservation, and AI tools are being deployed to transliterate Brahmi and Kaithi scripts into Hindi and English.
The state also announced plans for a National School of Drama (NSD) campus near Patna and reported strong registration on its dedicated film portal under the Bihar Film Promotion Policy.

bihar_news.title: CM Samrat Chaudhary Participates in Health Awareness Campaign Event in Patna
bullets: CM Samrat Choudhary and Health Minister Nishant Kumar participated in the health awareness campaign and mobile awareness vehicle event held at Urja Auditorium in Patna.
The event was organized as part of the state-wide healthcare drive aimed at improving early diagnosis and treatment access for major diseases.
Awareness chariots were flagged off to travel across villages and communities to spread preventive healthcare information.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches 'Jaanch evam Upchar, Chikitsa Aapke Dwar' Healthcare Campaign
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the 'Jaanch evam Upchar, Chikitsa Aapke Dwar' door-to-door healthcare campaign on September 2, 2026.

The campaign runs from September 2 to November 30 across all 38 districts, targeting around 6 crore people aged 30 and above to screen for non-communicable and serious diseases like diabetes, hypertension, cancer, and TB.
Over 63% of women in Bihar suffer from anaemia; the state plans to screen approximately 1 crore women and girls under this initiative and create digital health records linked with ABHA IDs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Power Minister Announces 1.1 kW Rooftop Solar Scheme for BPL Families
bullets: Bihar Power Minister Shailesh Kumar showcased the state's energy strides at 'Bharat Electricity 2026', themed 'Energy Sovereignty for a Climate-Resilient Viksit Bharat'.
The Bihar government announced a new scheme to provide free 1.1 kW rooftop solar systems to 2.5 lakh Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
Key achievements highlighted include installing over 94 lakh smart prepaid meters, lowering AT&C losses from 60% to 11.54%, and upcoming infrastructure like a 1,200 MW Pumped Storage Plant at Nawada.

bihar_news.title: Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar Manages Flood Surge from Nepal Rivers
bullets: Engineers opened all 36 gates of the 60-year-old Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar, Bihar, releasing nearly 1.5 lakh cusecs of water in a controlled manner.
The surge originated in Nepal following massive flooding in the Trishuli and Narayani rivers, which flow into the Gandak River.
The barrage structure played a critical role in regulated flood management and preventing severe downstream inundation in northern Bihar.

bihar_news.title: 40 Nursing Colleges in Bihar Lose Indian Nursing Council Recognition
bullets: The Indian Nursing Council (INC) withdrew recognition of 40 government and private nursing colleges in Bihar under Section 14 of the INC Act, 1947 due to faculty and infrastructure deficiencies.
Affected prominent institutions include GNM institutes at Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH), Bhagalpur Medical College Hospital, and BMIMS Pawapuri.
Graduates from derecognized institutions will become ineligible for recruitment in Central government hospitals, AIIMS, Indian Railways, and state nursing councils outside Bihar.

bihar_news.title: FM Sitharaman Pitches India as Global Manufacturing and Innovation Hub at G20 Meeting
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met 3M Chairman and CEO William Brown on the sidelines of the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting in Asheville, North Carolina.
She called on 3M to expand its investments in local supply-chain networks, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and R&D within India.
Discussions focused on leveraging India's deep talent pool, data security, and positioning India as an innovation platform for Asia-Pacific and global supply chains.

bihar_news.title: Water Release from Valmiki Nagar Barrage Inundates Parts of West Champaran
bullets: Around 180,000 cusecs of water was discharged from the Valmiki Nagar Gandak Barrage in West Champaran district following heavy rainfall and flooding in neighbouring Nepal.
The rising water levels of the Gandak River submerged critical transport routes connecting several villages in the Bagaha-2 block situated near the Valmiki Tiger Reserve.
As a precautionary safety measure, the Bihar district administration shifted more than 5,000 residents from low-lying vulnerable areas to safer locations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt to Launch 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal' for Teacher Grievance Redressal
bullets: The Bihar Education Department will launch the 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal' on September 5, 2026 (Teachers' Day) in Patna.
The portal acts as a single-window platform designed to address and resolve all teachers' grievances within a mandatory 30-day period.
Failure to resolve grievances within 30 days will trigger official inquiries against accountable departmental officers.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Completes Trial Run of 660 MW Unit-2 at Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: SJVN Limited completed the 72-hour trial run of the 660 MW Unit-2 of its 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar, moving it toward commercial operation.
The project is being constructed by SJVN Thermal Private Limited using supercritical technology for enhanced energy efficiency and lower environmental impact.
Once fully commissioned, both 660 MW units of the Buxar plant are expected to generate about 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually.

bihar_news.title: Proposed High-Speed Bullet Train Corridor to Connect Delhi, UP, and Bihar
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwani Vaishnaw announced a proposed high-speed rail corridor connecting Delhi to major cities in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, including Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Varanasi, and Patna.
The 1,170 km Delhi-Patna bullet train corridor is expected to reduce travel time between the national capital and Patna to 4.5 hours, and Delhi to Varanasi (945 km) to 3 hours 33 minutes.
This planned project represents the next phase of high-speed rail development after the 350 kmph design-speed Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor.

bihar_news.title: Bihar and Jharkhand Sign Historic Sone River Water Sharing Pact
bullets: Bihar and Jharkhand signed a water-sharing agreement for the Sone river, resolving a 25-year dispute originating after Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar in November 2000.

The allocation formula grants 5.75 million acre-feet (MAF) of water to Bihar and 2.0 MAF to Jharkhand, adhering to the 7.75 MAF share originally assigned to undivided Bihar under the 1973 Bansagar Agreement.

The resolution was mediated by the Central Water Commission (CWC) under the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti following discussions at the Eastern Zonal Council meeting chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces All-Women Mahila Vishwavidyalaya and Financial Support Schemes
bullets: Bihar announced plans for a proposed Mahila Vishwavidyalaya where all academic, administrative, faculty, and leadership positions (including Vice-Chancellor) will be reserved exclusively for women.

The state government disbursed approximately ₹600 crore via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to nearly 5 lakh beneficiaries under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana and outlined a target to spend ₹20,000 crore by 2030 for JEEViKA Didis.

The announcements were made during the launch of the Samriddh Mahila Samriddh Bihar Abhiyan in Patna, alongside an MoU signed with Prajapita Brahma Kumari Ishwariya Vishwavidyalaya for anti-addiction awareness.

bihar_news.title: Executive Notifications Cannot Be Applied Retrospectively Rules Patna High Court
bullets: Patna High Court ruled that beneficial executive policy decisions and resolutions of the government cannot be applied retrospectively in the absence of explicit statutory provision.
The ruling clarified that courts cannot expand the temporal scope or financial terms of an executive scheme beyond its stated text.
The case examined a 2005 Bihar government resolution that expanded extraordinary family pension benefits to all government personnel dying in harness due to acts of violence.

bihar_news.title: Finance Ministry Outlines Cycle for Union Budget Preparation
bullets: The Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), under the Ministry of Finance, issues the Budget Circular initiating pre-budget consultations chaired by the Secretary (Expenditure).
Financial Advisers of various ministries upload expenditure details onto the Union Budget Information System (UBIS) to finalize Budget Estimates and Revised Estimates.
Estimates for direct and indirect taxes, surcharges, and cesses are compiled and furnished by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).

bihar_news.title: Danapur-Bengaluru Express Upgraded to Daily Service from September 1
bullets: Indian Railways announced that the Danapur (Bihar) to Bengaluru (Karnataka) Express train service will operate daily from September 1, replacing its limited-frequency run.
The enhanced frequency aims to support high passenger movement, particularly migrant workers, students, and families traveling between eastern and southern India ahead of the festive season.
The upgrade improves direct long-distance rail connectivity for Bihar, offering a lower-cost and sustainable travel option between Danapur and India's major IT and economic hub.

bihar_news.title: NBCC and NHPC Sign MoU for Pan-India Infrastructure Projects
bullets: NBCC (India) Limited (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs) signed an MoU with NHPC Limited (Ministry of Power) for pan-India execution of infrastructure projects.
Under the agreement, NBCC will provide Project Management Consultancy (PMC) services for NHPC's buildings, residential blocks, office complexes, and allied works on a deposit work basis.
The partnership combines NHPC's hydropower expertise with NBCC's project execution capabilities to deliver standardized, sustainable, and time-efficient infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: SC Rules Higher Qualifications Cannot Override Prescribed Eligibility Criteria
bullets: A Supreme Court bench of Justices P.S. Narasimha and Alok Aradhe ruled that candidates with higher qualifications cannot claim appointment to posts with prescribed lower eligibility criteria.

The apex court observed that permitting overqualified candidates deprives genuinely eligible candidates who possess the prescribed minimum qualification, emphasizing strict adherence to advertised recruitment rules.
The judgment arose from a recruitment dispute under the Bihar Lab Technician Cadre Rules, 2014, regarding Diploma (DMLT) versus Bachelor (BMLT) qualification requirements.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Modernise 31 BSRTC Bus Stands on Gujarat's GSRTC Model
bullets: The Bihar Government approved the redevelopment of 31 Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC) bus stands under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, replicating Gujarat’s GSRTC Bus Port framework.

The terminals will feature EV charging stations, modern workshops, Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs), and commercial spaces housing 3,000–5,000 shops to generate recurring revenue for BSRTC.
Patna is designated to house the state's largest bus terminal, while Muzaffarpur will be developed as the primary transit hub for North Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inaugurates ₹249-Crore Karbigahia-Mithapur Flyover in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the first phase of the ₹249-crore Karbigahia-Mithapur flyover in Patna to ease urban traffic congestion.
The project includes a 2.1-km elevated road from Mithapur to Sipara, constructed as part of the broader Mithapur-Mahuli-Punpun project.
The flyover connects the Mithapur bus stand to the Mithapur roundabout via the Karbigahia roundabout, significantly improving access to Patna Railway Station, Mahuli, and Punpun.

bihar_news.title: Hydrological and Sedimentation Challenges of Bihar's Kosi River Highlighted
bullets: Severe flash floods at the Nepal-Tibet border renewed flood risk concerns across northern Bihar, particularly in the Kosi River basin.
The Kosi River (Saptakoshi) is formed by the confluence of the Sun Koshi, Arun Koshi, and Tamur Koshi at Triveni in Nepal before flowing into Bihar.
According to ICIMOD, the Kosi carries nearly 100 million tonnes of sediment annually at Chatara, causing frequent riverbed elevation changes and course avulsion.

bihar_news.title: Defence Minister Lays Foundation for ₹472-Crore T-Series Tank Overhaul Facility at Jabalpur
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh laid the foundation stone for a ₹472-crore facility to overhaul T-72 and T-90 battle tanks at the Vehicle Factory Jabalpur (VFJ).
The project aims to meet the Indian Army's annual maintenance requirements indigenously while integrating local MSMEs into the defence manufacturing supply chain.
The facility complements the Heavy Vehicles Factory at Avadi, Tamil Nadu, which has supplied around 4,400 tanks to the Indian Army over the last four decades.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Sugarcane Mechanisation Scheme 2026-27
bullets: Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department invites applications via the Cane Care and SUMEK portals to provide subsidies on 44 types of sugarcane agricultural machinery.
General category farmers receive up to 40% subsidy, whereas SC, ST, and EBC farmers receive an additional 10% (taking total support up to 50%).
Crop-residue management equipment attracts up to 75% subsidy (80% for SC/ST/EBC), and machinery banks set up by farmer groups get up to 80% project funding capped at Rs 8 lakh.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish JEEViKA-Sudha Sales Centres Across All 8,053 Panchayats
bullets: Under the 'Saat Nischay-3' initiative, Bihar will establish JEEViKA-Sudha sales centres across all 8,053 panchayats to strengthen rural milk businesses and support women-led livelihoods.
Selected 'Sudha Sakhis' will receive dairy storage equipment and training under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme, supported by COMFED's primary milk producers' cooperative network.

The plan also includes setting up 534 block-level animal medicine sales centres and establishing the Mithila Handicrafts Cooperative Society to export local handicrafts to Cambodia's Angkor Wat region.

bihar_news.title: Karbigahiya-Mithapur Flyover Phase-I and Mithapur-Sipara Elevated Road Inaugurated in Patna
bullets: Inaugurated the first phase of the Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover and the 2.1-km Mithapur-Sipara elevated road in Patna to reduce traffic congestion near Patna Railway Station.
The Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover project, including approach and service roads connecting Mithapur Bus Stand to Mithapur Roundabout, was constructed at a cost of Rs 249 crore.
The 2.1-km elevated road section from Mithapur to Sipara has been developed under the broader Mithapur-Mahuli-Punpun connectivity initiative.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Solar Energy Initiative for Jeevika Didis on Raksha Bandhan
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced a special Raksha Bandhan initiative to connect nearly 10 lakh Jeevika Didis' homes to solar energy.
Solar panels will be installed at their homes under the Prime Minister Surya Ghar scheme to reduce electricity expenses and generate additional income.
The move aims to promote clean energy, self-reliance, and sustainable livelihoods for women self-help group members in the state.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Bazaar Showcases Grassroots Enterprises including Bihar's Makhana Innovations
bullets: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries organized the PMFME Bazaar at the India Habitat Centre on August 24-25, featuring exhibitors from 25 States and UTs.
Launched on June 29, 2020, the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme provides a credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% up to Rs 10 lakh per unit.
Bihar's indigenous makhana was prominently showcased through value-added products like makhana-infused cookies developed by enterprises utilizing PMFME financial and technical support.

bihar_news.title: Nepal Flash Floods Raise Alarm in Bihar via Trishuli-Narayani-Gandak River System
bullets: A deadly flash flood, suspected to be a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Nepal-China border, impacted Nepal's Rasuwa district.
The Central Water Commission (CWC) tracked a sudden surge in the Trishuli and Bhote Koshi rivers, moving downstream into the Gandak river system affecting Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
The disaster caused severe casualties and trapped hundreds of Indian tourists, prompting coordinated disaster monitoring across Himalayan river basins.

bihar_news.title: UP-Bihar Border Villages on Alert Following Nepal Floods
bullets: Flash floods in Nepal triggered high alerts across the Uttar Pradesh-Bihar border, particularly affecting Kushinagar district.
Heavy rainwater accumulation and overflowing small drains disrupted connectivity, halting small vehicle movement and forcing reliance on tractor-trolleys.
Local administrations issued loudspeaker warnings for residents in border villages like Shivpur, Basantpur, and Marchahwa to move belongings and livestock to higher ground.

bihar_news.title: Impact Assessment of Bihar's Dedicated 'Pink Bus' Service for Women
bullets: The 'Pink Bus' service, announced in the Bihar State Budget 2025-26, offers safe and affordable mobility for women across Patna, Muzaffarpur, and Gaya with fares from ₹6 to ₹25.
An impact survey by MicroSave Consulting revealed that the service reduced daily travel costs for women by 28% to 35% compared to autos and e-rickshaws.
The service promotes inclusive employment by hiring female bus conductors, with 78% of total bus trips utilized for education and work participation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Becomes First State to Achieve 50 Lakh 'Lakhpati Didis'
bullets: Bihar became the first state in India to cross the milestone of 50 lakh women becoming 'Lakhpati Didis' through state-supported livelihood programs.
Under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rozgar Yojana, financial assistance was distributed to 1.81 crore women, with 3 lakh Jeevika Didis earning over ₹2 lakh annually.
CM Samrat Choudhary announced plans for a dedicated tracking mechanism for Lakhpati Didis and laid the foundation stone for a G+6 science block at Magadh Mahila College, Patna.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces Women-Only University and Balika PhD Fellowship
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the setting up of an all-women 'Mahila Vishwavidyalaya' where faculty, staff, and students will exclusively be women.
Disbursed ₹600 crore via Direct Benefit Transfer under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana, alongside setting a target to install solar panels for 10 lakh JEEViKA Didis by March 31.
Introduced the Chief Minister Balika PhD Fellowship providing ₹10,000 per month for four years to around 1,000 female research students to boost higher education.

bihar_news.title: GLOF Event at Tibet-Nepal Border Prompts NDRF Alert in Bihar and UP
bullets: A Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Tibet-Nepal border led to a sudden surge in the Trishuli River, threatening downstream areas along the Gandak River basin.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) positioned 9 teams in Bihar (including West Champaran and Muzaffarpur) and 11 teams in Uttar Pradesh for flood rescue operations.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Central Water Commission (CWC) are actively monitoring the downstream movement of floodwaters near the India-Nepal border.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Puts Districts on High Alert Following Flash Flood Warnings in Nepal's Gandak Catchment
bullets: The Bihar government intensified flood preparedness and placed districts along the Gandak river on high alert following warnings of a three-metre flash flood wave in Nepal's upper catchment area.

A high-level review meeting was chaired by Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit, instructing District Magistrates of vulnerable districts like West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali.
Authorities have pre-deployed emergency resources, including National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams to Gopalganj and Muzaffarpur, to ensure immediate rescue and evacuation if needed.

bihar_news.title: India Infrastructure Projects Face ₹3.40 Lakh Crore Cost Overrun: MoSPI Report
bullets: According to a July 2026 report by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), 1,775 ongoing infrastructure projects (each worth ₹150 crore and above) across 17 Central Ministries recorded a cumulative cost overrun of ₹3,40,504 crore.

The total revised cost of these monitored projects stands at ₹37,10,642 crore compared to the original cost of ₹33,70,138 crore, with cumulative expenditure reaching ₹19.26 lakh crore (51.91% of revised cost).
The Transport & Logistics sector accounts for the highest number of projects (1,246), with the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways leading with 993 projects worth ₹9.62 lakh crore.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Multiple Schemes for Women Safety, Higher Education and Entrepreneurship
bullets: Inaugurated the 'Police Didi (Abhaya Brigade)' initiative by flagging off 4,700 two-wheelers for women police personnel to enhance security around schools and colleges.
Launched the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship' scheme providing Rs 10,000 monthly fellowship for 4 years to nearly 1,000 female research scholars.
Rolled out the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme' offering financial assistance ranging from Rs 50,000 to Rs 2 lakh to 2,100 women entrepreneurs.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Appoints Ex-CJ of Orissa HC as Administrator of Bihar Cricket Association
bullets: The Supreme Court appointed Justice Chakradhari Sharan Singh, former Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court, as the administrator of the Bihar Cricket Association (BCA).
The decision follows recommendations in a report by BCA Ombudsman Justice L Nageswara Rao, which highlighted electoral discrepancies in the 2025 BCA elections.
The administrator is tasked with conducting a verification exercise across District Cricket Associations (DCAs), recalibrating the electoral college, and overseeing fresh elections.

bihar_news.title: NDRF Deploys 20 Teams in Bihar and UP Amid Gandak River Surge Threat
bullets: The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) deployed 20 teams across Bihar (9 teams) and Uttar Pradesh (11 teams) following a flood alert along the Gandak River.
The Central Water Commission (CWC) reported that a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Nepal-China border caused a sudden surge in Nepal's Trishuli River, downstream into the Gandak River.
Key border districts placed under high monitoring include West Champaran and Muzaffarpur in Bihar, and Kushinagar in Uttar Pradesh.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Rolls Out 'Police Didi' Campaign, JEEViKA Targets, and Student Support Portal
bullets: Deployed 2,700 scooties and 2,000 motorcycles for female police personnel under the 'Police Didi' campaign, aiming to lower 'Dial 112' emergency response times to 5–7 minutes.
Reported that 43 lakh women have become 'Lakhpati Didis' out of 1.81 crore JEEViKA-associated women in Bihar, with plans to add 1 lakh more over two years.
Launched 'Student Support Camps' to be held every fourth Tuesday at educational institutions alongside the Student Support Portal and Helpline 1100 for student grievance resolution.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Key Initiatives for Women's Empowerment and Safety
bullets: The Bihar government announced the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge', providing seed funding between ₹50,000 and ₹2 lakh to promote female entrepreneurs in the state.
Launched the 'Chief Minister Girl Child PhD Fellowship' scheme to provide ₹10,000 per month for four years to 1,000 female doctoral scholars.
Rolled out the 'Police Didi' (Abhaya Brigade) safety initiative equipping female police teams with 4,700 scooters and motorcycles to safeguard female students around educational institutions.

bihar_news.title: NITI Aayog Releases Report Titled ‘Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat’
bullets: NITI Aayog released a report titled ‘Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat’ highlighting structural imbalances in India's higher education system.
The report notes that combined undergraduate enrolment in B.A., B.Sc., and B.Com exceeds 2 crore out of 3.4 crore total students, with weak linkages to employment.
According to Economic Survey 2024–25 data cited in the report, only 8.25 percent of graduates are employed in roles aligned to their qualifications, while graduate unemployment stands at 13 percent.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025 Highlighted by Industries Minister
bullets: Bihar Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh highlighted the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025 as a competitive industrial policy in the country.
Key incentives under the policy include virtually free land for large employment generation, interest subventions of up to Rs 40 crore, and state GST reimbursement.
The state government reported rapid project execution, citing the setup of a manufacturing unit from inception to production within a record 55 days.

bihar_news.title: IndiGo Launches Direct Gaya-Bangkok Flights to Boost Buddhist Tourism
bullets: IndiGo announced twice-weekly direct international flights connecting Gaya in Bihar with Bangkok, Thailand, commencing October 26, 2026.
The route significantly enhances air connectivity for Bodh Gaya, home to the UNESCO World Heritage Site Mahabodhi Temple, catering to international Buddhist pilgrims.
The new connectivity aims to strengthen Bihar's tourism ecosystem, cultural exchange, hospitality, and local transport infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Partners with ConveGenius.AI for State AI Stack
bullets: The Department of Information Technology, Bihar, signed an MoU with ConveGenius.AI to build the state's sovereign AI stack and infrastructure.
The project involves creating 'B-ONT', an ontological mind map acting as a unified knowledge graph for all state schemes and cross-departmental citizen services.
Under the agreement, the Government of Bihar retains full control over its data, AI governance, and policy controls while enhancing youth upskilling in AI capabilities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Leads National Mushroom Production Surge, Accounts for 12.02% Share
bullets: India's mushroom production surged from 51,000 tonnes in 2015 to 347,750 tonnes in 2024, registering a CAGR of 23.76%, according to FAO and ICAR data.
Bihar has emerged as the top producer in India, contributing 12.02% of total national output in 2023-24, followed by Odisha (9.86%) and Maharashtra (9.49%).
Growth was driven by initiatives under the Bihar Agriculture Roadmap, Mushroom Kit Vitaran Scheme, and training support from Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Raises Concerns Over Renewal of 1996 Farakka Ganga Water Treaty
bullets: Bihar has raised concerns over flooding, siltation, and dry-season water availability ahead of the expiration of the 1996 India-Bangladesh Ganga Water Sharing Treaty in December 2026.
The 1996 Farakka Treaty establishes a 30-year formula-based framework for water sharing at Farakka Barrage (West Bengal) during the lean period (January 1 to May 31).
Bihar has requested scientific silt management, higher state representation in discussions, and accounting for its projected water requirements up to 2050.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Proposes ₹70,000-Crore Extension for Ganga Marine Drive
bullets: Bihar announced a proposal to construct a 126-kilometre Marine Drive corridor along the Ganga River at an estimated cost of ₹70,000 crore.
The proposed funding structure comprises ₹20,000 crore from the Bihar state government and ₹50,000 crore expected from private sector investment.
The planned project will extend the existing 21-km J.P. Ganga Path in Patna towards Koilwar on the Son River to improve riverfront infrastructure and connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Participates in National Conference of Information and Public Relations Secretaries
bullets: Bihar Information and Public Relations Department (IPRD) Secretary Naveen Kumar represented the state at the National Conference of State Information Secretaries in New Delhi.
Key agenda items included strengthening PIB-State IPRD coordination, utilizing IIMC for officer training, and digital transition via the Press Sewa Portal under the PRP Act, 2023.
Delegates deliberated on the 'WAVES 2027' framework, 'WAVES Bazaar', and the adoption of the 'India Cine Hub' single-window portal for film shooting permissions.

bihar_news.title: Congress Demands Adoption of Bihar and Telangana Models for Nationwide Caste Census
bullets: The Indian National Congress has urged the Registrar General of India and the Ministry of Home Affairs to adopt the Bihar and Telangana state models for the upcoming nationwide caste census.
The party advocated replacing open-ended queries with a standardized drop-down menu format based on existing state and central caste lists to prevent data duplication.
Criticism was directed at the Union Home Ministry's 40-question census format notification, which places caste as a single open-ended query at question number 10.

bihar_news.title: SC Clarifies Electoral Roll Exclusion Does Not Void Citizenship or Social Welfare Rights
bullets: The Supreme Court clarified that deletion from electoral rolls following Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Bihar does not automatically lead to the loss of citizenship or denial of social welfare benefits.

The bench noted that the Election Commission of India (ECI) conducts enquiries strictly for electoral eligibility, which does not constitute a formal determination of citizenship under the Citizenship Act.
Individuals facing denial of Public Distribution System (PDS) ration or domicile certificates due to voter list exclusion retain the right to seek remedies before the High Court.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves Six-Lane Greenfield Corridor from Buxar to Bhagalpur
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet approved a 336-km six-lane greenfield road corridor connecting Buxar with Bhagalpur, chaired by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.
The corridor will pass through multiple districts including Bhojpur, Arwal, Jehanabad, Nalanda, Munger, Sheikhpura, Banka, Gaya, Nawada, Jamui, and Lakhisarai.

The project will be implemented through the Bihar State Road Development Corporation Limited (BSRDCL), with the IT Department also partnering with Japanese firm Tayo for an AI-based infrastructure platform.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Announces 'Mati Kala Board' for Artisans' Welfare
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the establishment of a 'Mati Kala Board' (Terracotta Art Board) within three months to preserve traditional clay art and promote the Kumhar (Prajapati) community.
The Board will systematically focus on providing modern technology, skill development training, and improved market access to traditional clay artisans.
The announcement was made at Shri Krishna Memorial Hall in Patna during a memorial program honoring 13-year-old freedom struggle martyr Ramchandra Vidyarthi.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹70,000 Crore Expansion of JP Ganga Path to Koilwar
bullets: The Bihar government proposed extending the existing 21-km JP Ganga Path into a 126-km Ganga riverfront corridor reaching Koilwar on the Sone River.
The project involves an estimated outlay of ₹70,000 crore, comprising ₹20,000 crore state budgetary support and ₹50,000 crore from private investments.
The corridor aims to modernize state urban infrastructure, enhance regional connectivity, and boost economic activities along the riverfront.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces New Industrial Initiatives and Governance Metrics at ET World Leaders Forum
bullets: Bihar unveiled the 'Build Bihar, Believe in Bihar' initiative at the ET World Leaders Forum to push for rapid industrialization and employment generation.
The 'Sahyog Grievance Redressal Program' has enforced a strict 30-day deadline for public grievances, achieving a 96% resolution rate out of 6,42,000 applications.
State policy developments include tailored packages for Semiconductors and Global Capability Centres (GCCs), alongside increasing total irrigated area from 2.1 million to 4.4 million hectares.

bihar_news.title: Parliamentary Panel Reviews Transport, Infrastructure, and Heritage Projects in Bihar
bullets: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism, and Culture, chaired by Sanjay Jha, undertook a three-day review visit to Bihar.
The committee reviewed critical infrastructure projects, including the Patna-Purnia Expressway, Gorakhpur-Siliguri Expressway, NH-27 repairs, and the proposed greenfield international airport.
Assessments were conducted on heritage sites and cultural institutions including the Bihar Museum, Khuda Bakhsh Library, Kumrahar ASI site, Bodh Gaya, and Rajgir.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Constitutes 5-Member Panel for Examination System Reforms
bullets: The General Administration Department of Bihar formed a five-member expert committee to recommend comprehensive reforms in the state's examination framework.
The panel will review procedures across state examination boards, commissions, universities, and recruitment agencies from candidate registration to result declaration.
Primary focus areas include strengthening security protocols to prevent question paper leaks, impersonation, cheating, and result tampering.

bihar_news.title: Union Minister Announces 11.19 Lakh PMAY Houses and PMFBY Implementation in Bihar
bullets: Union Agriculture and Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan approved 11,18,937 pucca houses for Bihar under PMAY with a financial allocation of ₹13,427 crore.
The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) will be re-implemented in Bihar to cover farmer crop losses caused by natural calamities like floods and drought.
The government proposed setting up 'She-Marts' in every district to provide marketing avenues for Jeevika Didis and women Self-Help Groups (SHGs).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Clarifies Funding Pattern for Student Credit Card Scheme
bullets: The Bihar government clarified that the loan limit under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme remains unchanged at ₹4 lakh.
Under the revised setup, Bihar State Education Finance Corporation will fund up to ₹2 lakh, while scheduled commercial banks will provide the remaining amount up to ₹4 lakh.
The scheme has been linked with the PM Vidyalaxmi portal, and the state expenditure allocation was raised from ₹886 crore to ₹950 crore for FY 2026-27.

bihar_news.title: 100 Acres Identified for Proposed Sugar Mill in Pirpainti, Bihar
bullets: The Bhagalpur district administration identified 100 acres of land in Pirpainti to set up a proposed modern sugar mill.
A detailed site report has been submitted by District Magistrate Alankrita Pandey to Bihar's Sugarcane Development Department for departmental approval.
Pirpainti accounts for the largest area under sugarcane cultivation in Bhagalpur district, alongside Nathnagar and Sultanganj blocks.

bihar_news.title: Chhattisgarh Becomes First Inland State to Export Value-Added Tilapia Products
bullets: Chhattisgarh became the first inland state in India to export value-added Tilapia fish products, dispatching 382 tonnes to the United States.
Under the central scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), Chhattisgarh has invested nearly ₹900 crore, boosting fish production to approximately 10 lakh tonnes.
The export initiative was reviewed in Raipur by the Secretary, Department of Fisheries (Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying) in partnership with NFDB, MPEDA, and NABARD.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Vendor Establishes Bakery Enterprise Under PMFME Scheme
bullets: Sanjit Kumar, a resident of Sheikhpura district in Bihar, successfully set up a bakery business utilizing credit-linked support under the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme.
The PMFME Scheme was launched in 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan to address financial, technical, and market linkage constraints faced by unorganised micro food processing enterprises.
The bakery enterprise generates local employment and supplies products across Sheikhpura, Nawada, and Lakhisarai districts in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches 'One Officer, One Model School' System for Education Reform
bullets: Bihar Government directed the Education Department to implement the 'One Officer, One Model School' system to link administrative officers directly with individual schools for time-bound resolution of operational issues.
State model schools, named Saraswati Vidya Niketan, will conduct mandatory parent-teacher meetings every three months and actively engage alumni for student mentorship.
The initiative mandates specialized coaching resources for government school students preparing for competitive exams like JEE and NEET.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Detects Over 87,600 TB Cases in Massive Statewide Screening Drive
bullets: Bihar's State Health Society screened 2.36 crore people during an intensive campaign from July 2 to August 14, 2026, detecting 87,623 tuberculosis cases.
Out of the total detected cases, 21,550 patients were asymptomatic and identified through active target testing.
The state diagnostic infrastructure currently utilizes 491 digital X-ray machines (including 140 AI-powered ultraportable handheld units), 89 CBNAAT machines, and 562 Truenat machines.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves CoEs for Regional Languages and ₹13,427 Crore Housing Package
bullets: The Bihar Government announced the setting up of Centres of Excellence for regional languages—Bhojpuri, Magahi, Maithili, and Angika—under SCERT Patna, alongside launching the 'Bihar Vidyavani' podcast.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan approved 11.18 lakh pucca houses for Bihar with an outlay of ₹13,427 crore under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY).
The state will implement Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) to cover crop failure risks and establish district-level She-Marts for Jeevika Didis.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Scheme Drives Micro-Enterprise Growth in Bihar's Sheikhpura District
bullets: A local vendor in Sheikhpura district, Bihar, successfully established a micro-bakery enterprise and created local employment by leveraging credit assistance under the PMFME scheme.
The Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme was launched in 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
PMFME is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme designed to address credit access, modern technology adoption, branding, and market linkage constraints faced by micro-food processing units in India.
